body: Root cause is on BUG-2624 (comment just added). tests/test_containment_conformance.py::test_continuation_restores_terminal_stdin_without_secret_argv mocks a Popen child with no pid. MagicMock's index is 1, so on a foreground TTY scripts/containment/conformance.py:668 runs os.killpg(1, SIGTERM) = kill(-1): every process Joe owns, so the session logs out. Both kills were an agy showcase agent running make check-ci-fast interactively. The cron tick is exonerated. Recommend raising BUG-2624 to critical and putting it first in the lane queue. Until the fix lands, no seat runs check-ci-fast from an interactive terminal.
subject: URGENT BUG-2624 root cause: check-ci-fast kills the whole user session from a TTY
